subject: general
question: The snake boat race is a unique feature of which of the following festivals?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Onam.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Boat races of Kerala are a special feature of Onam.**
 
• Onam is the **harvest festival** **of Kerala** which is celebrated to welcome King Mahabali.
 
• Depending on the Malayalam Calendar, the festival falls in the month of** August or September **and lasts for **4-10 days.**
 
• Celebrations involve songs, dance, games, and feasts.
 
• **The Snake Boat Race called Vallamkali **is carried out on the** Pampa river** with hundreds of people racing and chanting folk songs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kalinga Festival**

 
 
• ​**Kalinga Mahotsav** is one of the most famous festivals of** Orissa.**
 
• It holds great religious significance for people.
 
• The aim of this festival is **to encourage people to follow the path of peace and calm,** rather than fighting amongst themselves.
 
• The** Vishwa Shanti Stupa,** also called the Peace Pagoda, serves as the **venue **of the Kalinga Mahotsav.
 
 
 
• **Bhogali Bihu**
 
 
• ​Magh Bihu or Bhogali Bihu is a **celebration of bountiful nature and abundance.**
 
• It is also an **occasion for the people of Assam to enjoy (bhog kora)** and share in the gifts of nature as a community, and strengthen a sense of identity and belonging.
 
 
 
• **Dussehra**
 
 
• ​Dussehra, also called Dasara or** Vijayadashami, in Hinduism.**
 
• The Festival marks the **triumph of Lord Rama,** an avatar of Vishnu, over the **10-headed demon king Ravana**, who abducted Lord Rama's wife, Sita.
